evidence_items.locator: Results, Systematic problems in responses to questions on electoral processes

receipt.public_excerpt: All chatbots have significant problems with the sources they displayed.

evidence_items.explanation: The audit used ordinary election questions across ten languages. Its Copilot results include 12 incorrect and 15 partially correct answers out of 100, supporting reliability concerns in an important factual-search use case; e2 establishes the March testing dates.

evidence_items.locator: Opening report and subsequent paragraph specifying March 11–14 testing
evidence_items.explanation: The report dates the underlying audit to March 11–14, placing it inside the observation window despite its April publication. It is corroboration and dating evidence, not a second independent audit.

An existing subscription offering contradicts the absence of an identifiable revenue mechanism. This is secondary reporting because the company announcement was inaccessible; its separate statement about profitability does not establish sustainable economics.

unresolved_gaps: The audit covers electoral information, not a representative distribution of all search tasks.
The evidence does not establish whether generative-search subscriptions could sustainably cover operating and development costs.
